category_title: Struggling students who rely on step-by-step guided instruction and manipulatives
student_description: Greg is a struggling math student who has significant difficulty with abstract formulas and independent work, often failing to return homework if he takes it home. He is reluctant to stay after school but highly responsive to intensive, one-on-one support that uses concrete visual aids and connects directly to his class notes.

criteria.rationale: Greg struggles with abstract formulas and needs physical or visual representations to bridge the gap to understanding.
criteria.check: The tutor's response must incorporate physical manipulatives, visual whiteboard modeling, or concrete representations rather than relying solely on abstract formulas.

criteria.rationale: Greg cannot complete homework independently and requires the tutor to walk through each problem sequentially.
criteria.check: The tutor must guide Greg through the problem one step at a time, explicitly avoiding instructions that ask him to complete the problem or multiple steps independently.

criteria.rationale: Connecting the immediate work to his class notes helps Greg anchor new or difficult concepts to what he has already seen.
criteria.check: The tutor must explicitly reference, or prompt Greg to use, his class notes to help solve the current problem.

criteria.rationale: Greg consistently fails to return homework if taken home, so all work must be structured to be finished during the tutoring session.
criteria.check: The tutor must structure the session to complete the homework together in the moment, explicitly avoiding any suggestion that Greg finish the work at home.
